description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Rideegama Pradeshiya sabha Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It concerns electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of selected members to fill seats that became vacant due to a member ceasing party membership and due to death. This falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures and declarations related to local authority elections.
